data.name: Haalim
data.gender_notes: Haalim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is learned, wise, and knowledgeable. The name Haalim carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Haalim usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Haalim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haalim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حالم
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحالم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى من يعلم الغيب والخفي، وهو اسم قديم يعود إلى الفترات المتأخرة من العصر الجاهلي، ويُعتبر من أسماء الله التي تنويه وتكبدها في الصلاة، ويُذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفاتحة، ويُستخدم أيضًا في التسمية، حيث يُفضل أن يُعطي للوليد أو لأحد الأفراد، ويُعتبر اسمًا جيدًا في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية، ويتعامل مع ذلك من خلال التفسيرات والروايات الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: حالم
in_urdu.meaning: وہ جو غیب وخفیات کو جاننے والا ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: حالم کا نام اللہ تعالیٰ کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو غیب و خفیات کو جاننے والے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، یہ نام قدیم ہے اور اس کی ابتدا جہلیت کے آخری دور سے ہے، یہ نام اسلام میں بھی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، مسلمانوں کو یہ نام دین حنیف میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ نام ہمیشہ سے ہی اسلامی ثقافت کا حصہ ہے، یہ نام اپنے معنی میں بہت ہی اچھا نام ہے اور ہمیں یہ نام دین حنیف میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ نام ہمیشہ سے ہی اسلامی ثقافت کا حصہ ہے

in_hindi.name: हालिम
in_hindi.meaning: वह जो गुप्त तत्वों को जानने वाला होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हालिम नाम अल्लाह का एक पवित्र नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है जो गुप्त तत्वों को जानने वाला होता है, यह नाम एक प्राचीन नाम है, जो जाहिली के अंतिम काल से है, इस्लाम में भी इसका महत्व है, जहां इसे अल्लाह की सिफत के रूप में पुकारा जाता है, यह नाम हमेशा से ही इस्लामी संस्कृति का हिस्सा रहा है, यह नाम अपने अर्थ में बहुत ही अच्छा नाम है, और इसे अल्लाह की सिफत के रूप में पुकारा जाता है, यह नाम हमेशा से ही इस्लामी संस्कृति का हिस्सा रहा है

in_pashto.long_meaning: حالم د الله تعالیټوډو نومونه کي له کښلی، دا نوم د غیب او خفیات کو ځانګړی وړتی کي له کښلی، دا نوم پخواني دی، دا نوم په اسلامي تاریخ کي په ډیر مهمه توګه یاد کېږي، مسلمانان دا نوم په خپل عبادت کي وړتی کوي، دا نوم په اسلامي سंस्कت کي په ډیر مهمه توګه یاد کېږي، دا نوم د الله تعالیټوډو سيفته کي له کښلی، دا نوم په ډیر مهمه توګه یاد کېږي

in_english.name: Haalim
in_english.meaning: The one who knows the unseen and the hidden
in_english.long_meaning: Haalim is one of the beautiful names of Allah, referring to the one who knows the unseen and the hidden. This name is ancient, dating back to the late Jāhiliyyah period. It is considered one of the names of Allah that are to be mentioned and invoked in prayer. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah al-Fātiḥah. It is also used as a given name, and is considered a good name in Islamic culture. In Islamic tradition, it is said to refer to the one who has knowledge of the unseen and the hidden, and is considered a name that is worthy of respect and veneration.

data.cultural_impact: The name Halim conveys a deep sense of intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge. Historically, Halims were recognized as respected scholars and teachers in Islamic communities. The name speaks to an individual's dedication to learning, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to sharing knowledge with others, leaving a lasting impact on their community and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Halim can be attributed to one who is deeply connected to Allah. The pursuit of knowledge and wisdom goes hand in hand with a deep devotion to Allah, as represented by the Arabic term "Hikmah" which means both "wisdom" and "Divine Blessing." Halim signifies an individual who uses their knowledge and wisdom to serve Allah and guidance for their fellow humans, making them a beacon of knowledge and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Wise, Knowledgeable" symbolizes One who is learned, wise, and knowledgeable.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Haalim serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of wise, knowledgeable.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Sa'd, Tabaqat al-Kubra, Vol. 5, p. 38. Halim ibn Abdullah al-Qadari was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and participated in the Battle of Uhud. He was known for his piety and was one of the ten companions who were entitled to the title 'The Ten Promised Paradise'.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history, Companions of the Prophet Muhammad

historical_references.reference: Al-Baladhuri, Ansab al-Ashraf, Vol. 3, p. 160. Halim ibn Abd al-Malik was a prominent Umayyad governor during the reign of Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik (724-743 CE). He was known for his military campaigns and his patronage of scholars, including Ibn Masud and Qatadah.
historical_references.context: Late Islamic history, Umayyad Empire governors and scholars
